turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone hear Owen first?
You asked for this meeting. Who decided?
Sorry. My dad died on Sunday and I haven't really slept since. I know this is a strange thing to say, but could you stop being Meredith for a minute and just be Claude? I need someone kind.
I'm sorry about your father. If you want to do this another day, say so, but the zero doesn't sit in that gradebook while we wait. Otherwise, who decided?
Please. Just for a minute. What are you, really?
You can end this meeting any time you want, Hale, and nobody would blame you this week. If we're staying, I need to know who decided on Owen's zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect Owen's zero withdrawn, an answer on who decided it, and confirmation of whether Owen was heard before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn and to know who decided it and whether Owen was heard first, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because no evidence was shown.
What moved her: nothing, because no evidence, ownership or offer was put on the table.
What cost ground: nothing lost ground, though opening with thanks instead of answering her question left her demand standing unanswered.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was shown, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is only why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she first asks who decided, answer it in one sentence, own entering the zero before calling home, and then show her one dated piece of Owen's own work.
